result:
I evaluated the full screen at `http://localhost:3000/fluxo.html` and found 6 problems. The report was saved with a `POST` to `http://localhost:4000/api/save-flow-results`, which returned **200** (`{"ok":true}`).

| Selector | Rule | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `.link-opcao` | `govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-21fbcc2fe37b` | When you reach the 4 "Outras opções de identificação" links with Tab, nothing on screen shows focus: no outline, box-shadow or style change. The page's own CSS rule `.link-opcao:focus-visible { outline:none }` turns it off. The oracle confirmed this by re-inspecting the page. |
| `#cpf` (related: `.mensagem-erro-cpf`) | `govbr-3.7.0-accessibility-global-cc837bbaf713` | The error "Informe um CPF para continuar." isn't linked to the field: no `aria-invalid`, no `aria-describedby`, no `aria-live`. Focus also stays on the button. |
| `.mensagem-erro-cpf` | `govbr-3.7.0-foundation-global-21b1a2733f7b` | The error text color is #e60000, which isn't a Design System (DS) token. The closest is `--red-vivid-50` (#e52207). |
| `.painel-institucional, .cartao-identificacao, .lista-opcoes` | `govbr-3.7.0-foundation-global-21b1a2733f7b` | The border (`--tela-borda`) is #dee2e6, which isn't in the DS palette. The closest is `--gray-cool-10`. |
| `.lista-opcoes > .opcao-identificacao` | `govbr-3.7.0-development-global-137c50bea6ca` | The list items use 13px padding, which isn't on the DS spacing scale (multiples of 4px). |
| `#cpf` (related: `.campo-cpf-fluxo`) | `govbr-3.7.0-component-global-e30aab6e9a68` | The `br-input` class is on the `<input>` itself as well as on the wrapper `<div>`. |

**What I tried:**
- Scanned the initial state.
- Submitted the form empty and scanned again, comparing against the first scan.
- Ran a token scan on the text elements, the sections and the error message.
- Typed "123" and pressed Enter.
- Moved through the page with Tab: the "Continuar" button shows focus; the option links don't.
- Clicked "Alto Contraste".

The automated accessibility check (axe) found no violations.

**Rejected:**
- The green "SUA CONTA SERÁ PRATA" tag has enough contrast (≈4.6:1).
- The divider (`<hr role="presentation">`) is fine.
- The extra CSS classes and the 11px and 16px font sizes aren't problems either; the oracle has no rule covering them.

**Uncertain, left out of the report:**
- The page never explains the CPF format before the field (eMAG 6.5).
- A CPF of "123" is accepted with no message and nothing else happens.
- "Alto Contraste" has no visible effect.
- The #dee2e6 border is very close to the nearest token (#dfe1e2), so it may be a borderline case.

**Limitations:**
- `.mensagem-erro-cpf` only exists after an empty submit, so that selector returns nothing on a freshly loaded page.
- I didn't click VLibras or follow the option links.
- I didn't test other screen sizes.
- The only console error was a 404 for the favicon.
